notes: Variant v009 is underdetermined over πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσεται and the projection carries r00-base; nothing here decides it.

Reading As as ὅτι's displaced English is defensible but would cross the quotation's opening clause; it is marked added under rule 86 instead, and ὅτι is left unrepresented, the ASV writing no complementizer for it.
τῷ θεῷ → to God keeps the case preposition on the noun, the article having no determiner to anchor (rules 21, 23).
